context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
Problem (goal): the coordinator took this undoable pick on Nov 12, 12:01 CST without asking you; it stands unless you choose b.
Based on (notes): coordinator 12:10 CST Nov 12, from its list of today's picks.
Departs from: main has no such pick on record — the work it governs follows this pick.

options.gain: A stalled review shows up after three days instead of never.
options.how: The PR ledger gives a fix check, a fresh full review and a lane's round 2 or later a 72 h limit (unmeasured). A record marked done whose lane check never passed belongs to its lane, not to the batch runner.
options.label: Keep the pick (Recommended)
options.lose: The other route is not taken unless you choose b.

options.gain: The other route, if you prefer it.
options.how: No time limit in the ledger.
options.label: Overrule it
options.lose: The governed work is redone or waits for the change.

reply: Closed 13:19 CST: the retrospective's audit found the pick sound for now, but the 72 hours were a guess. Step pr-ledger-round-ages measures how old review rounds really get and replaces the 72 hours with that measure.
short: PR ledger: a 72 h limit for fix checks and later rounds
title: PR ledger: a 72 h limit for fix checks and later rounds
why: A coordinator pick you could not see before.
